title: Successive graph projection and compactification-prefix factorization
statement: Let B be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category admitting functorial flat resolutions and the exact-pullback/flatness and concrete sheaf-composition structures used by the ordinary unbounded etale six functors [def-kun-derived-tensor, def-kun-projection-formula-map, lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor, lem-kun-derived-pullback-composition-monoidal]. For proper a:X→W, open e:W→P, proper p:P→Y and f=a e p, construct the successive graph-word projection from Rp_*De_!Ra_*M tensor K to Rp_*De_!Ra_*(M tensor Lf*K) by the proper projection for p, the open tensor comparison for e, the proper projection for a, and the two inverse canonical pullback compositors. If f0:W→Y has a compactification c=(i,p) [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and f=a f0, this word for (a,i,p) equals PF_c on Ra M,K, followed by F_c of the proper projection for a at Lf0*K, followed by F_c Ra of M tensor the inverse compositor for a,f0. The assertion holds for arbitrary unbounded complexes and schemes, with neither quasi-compactness nor invertibility of a projection map assumed. In particular it applies to B=ModuleCat A for every commutative coefficient ring A.

proof.text: Construct the word by composing the actual proper, open, and proper projection components and applying the two inverse pullback compositor components. This is precisely the componentwise form of the original graph-word formula: the functor associator contributes the identity. Keep the coefficient category and the three morphisms as parameters, so the construction and its API use the same derived-category structures.

Apply the existing projectionMapOfCompactification_explicit formula to c and Ra M,K. It expands PF_c as the proper projection for p, its image of the open tensor comparison, and its image of M tensor the inverse compositor for i,p.

Naturality of the proper projection for a at the inverse compositor c_i,p moves that coefficient map past the projection. The inverse threefold pullback associativity identity La(c_i,p inverse) followed by c_a,ip inverse equals c_a,i inverse followed by c_ai,p inverse. Apply M tensor this identity, then functoriality and associativity to paste the expansion. Its right side is the successive graph word by its definition. No compactification equality is eliminated.

lean.statement:
theorem sfGraphProjectionWord_proper_prefix
    {X W Y : Scheme.{u}} {f₀ : W ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f₀)
    (a : X ⟶ W) [IsProper a] (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f = a ≫ f₀)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B))
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B)) :
    let S := (lowerStar B a).rightDerivedFunctor
    let F := rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification B c
    sfGraphProjectionWord B a c.i c.g f
      (by rw [← c.comm, ← hf]) M K =
      ((projectionMapOfCompactification B c).app (S.obj M)).app K ≫
        F.map (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap B a).app M).app
          ((upperStar B f₀).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)) ≫
        F.map (S.map (((derivedTensor B X).obj M).map
          ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp B a f₀ f hf).inv.app K)))
